title: How does Pinnacle Blooms Network measure progress during occupational therapy sessions?
metaTitle: Tracking Therapy Progress at Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Learn how Pinnacle Blooms Network expertly tracks and measures progress during occupational therapy sessions for your child's consistent development.
html: At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we track the progress of your child against individualized goals that are established at the onset of therapy. To measure the advancement, our certified occupational therapists use various standardized assessments and make regular observations during the interactions with your child. Our comprehensive techniques are designed to capture nuanced improvements and contribute towards the skill-building process and overall development of your child.
